objective: Classify every current machine row with a nonempty blocked_on field as EVIDENCE, DEPENDENCY, GOVERNANCE_CONTROL, OWNER_POLICY, or DELEGATED_OWNER_OVERRIDE using newer banked evidence, and give the cheapest own-merits falsifier for every true DEPENDENCY row.

governing_lesson.rank_order: local node-disjoint swap > global re-solve > broad cost bonus >> full cost replacement
governing_lesson.design_consequence: The audit may propose only narrow, high-precision, local, recall-preserving falsifiers; it may not propose a whole-pool rescore or rerank.

classification_rule.EVIDENCE: A banked scientific or resource outcome now supports the park, including when it supersedes a stale machine dependency.
classification_rule.DEPENDENCY: The scientific mechanism has not received its own outcome because a missing input or upstream artifact still blocks it.
classification_rule.GOVERNANCE_CONTROL: The row is an enabling or execution control, not a scientific candidate.
classification_rule.OWNER_POLICY: The owner has explicitly forbidden the resource or action.
classification_rule.DELEGATED_OWNER_OVERRIDE: The owner explicitly opened a separately named current lane; this audit does not prejudge it.

hard_disqualifiers: any graph, 6bba, CV57, GPU, Kaggle, RunPod, or submission action
any proposal that rescored or reranked a complete action pool
any repeat of a DEAD or terminal mechanism without a new name
any scientific conclusion drawn from an absent dependency
local_validation: cover every tier_census row whose blocked_on array is nonempty
exactly one cause class per covered row
a nonempty cheapest_own_merits_falsifier for every DEPENDENCY row
tier_move_proposed is false for every row
lane edit_set_size is zero and graph delta is the exact no-op vector
kill_line: Fail the audit if coverage is incomplete, any tier move is proposed, or any dependency row lacks a bounded own-merits falsifier.
